verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the concrete storage rule that each task deliverable must be placed in its linked Google folder.
Target-specific implementation claim reporting that the CRM deliverable was placed in its corresponding Google document.
The observed problem is the inability to locate a destination link, which belongs to REQ_DELIVERABLE_LINK_INCLUSION rather than the rule governing where work must be stored.
The client establishes the concrete document destination for the Task 1 CRM deliverable; the new key does not conflict with or replace an existing value.
